payload.body: The AC-1/AC-2 integration regression (harness process holds an open OS pipe as its own stdin, imports parrot which installs uvloop, then calls the REAL production CodexCodeDispatcher._create_process() via uvloop.run() to spawn a grandchild) fails 100% reproducibly when run inside this repo's full pytest session (packages/ai-parrot/tests/flows/dev_loop/), even after 3 retries — the grandchild's fd0 was verified via /proc/<pid>/fd to be the harness's own stdin pipe inode, not /dev/null, despite _create_process() correctly passing stdin=asyncio.subprocess.DEVNULL (verified independently and deterministically by test_spawn_isolates_stdin in the same file). The identical harness+child scripts, spawned the identical way (stdlib subprocess.Popen, close_fds=True), pass reliably every time when run as a standalone script OUTSIDE pytest (multiple confirmed reproductions). The harness's own /proc/<pid>/fd table shows 2 extra open sockets present only in the pytest-driven run that do not appear in the standalone reproduction, despite close_fds=True on the Popen call, suggesting the full pytest session's accumulated process state affects a subsequent fork+exec's fd landscape in a way that trips a libuv/uvloop 0.21.0 subprocess-spawn DEVNULL-handling bug. This is not a defect in _create_process() or the hotfix; suggested follow-up: reproduce with a minimal pytest fixture set to bisect which conftest.py fixture/import introduces the extra descriptors, or file upstream against uvloop with a minimal repro, or accept a documented xfail/skip for this one test in CI while relying on test_spawn_isolates_stdin (deterministic mock) for the DEVNULL-kwarg contract.

The identical harness+child scripts, spawned the identical way (stdlib subprocess.Popen, close_fds=True), pass reliably every time when run as a standalone script OUTSIDE pytest (multiple confirmed reproductions). The harness's own /proc/<pid>/fd table shows 2 extra open sockets present only in the pytest-driven run that do not appear in the standalone reproduction, despite close_fds=True on the Popen call, suggesting the full pytest session's accumulated process state affects a subsequent fork+exec's fd landscape in a way that trips a libuv/uvloop 0.21.0 subprocess-spawn DEVNULL-handling bug. This is not a defect in _create_process() or the hotfix; suggested follow-up: reproduce with a minimal pytest fixture set to bisect which conftest.py fixture/import introduces the extra descriptors, or file upstream against uvloop with a minimal repro, or accept a documented xfail/skip for this one test in CI while relying on test_spawn_isolates_stdin (deterministic mock) for the DEVNULL-kwarg contract.
